{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_orders = data[qa_mask]
num_qa_orders = len(qa_orders)

# Identify completed orders
completed_mask = data['status'] == 'completed'
completed_data = data[completed_mask]
num_completed_orders = len(completed_data)

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_data = data[~completed_mask]
num_refunded_orders = len(refunded_data)

# Final data: completed orders excluding QA
final_data = completed_data[~qa_mask]
num_final_rows = len(final_data)

# Compute total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = final_data.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Extract max channel and revenue
max_channel = revenue_by_channel.loc[revenue_by_channel['revenue_clean'].idxmax(), 'channel']
max_revenue = revenue_by_channel['revenue_clean'].max()

# Print all key numbers explicitly
print(f'num_qa_orders: {num_qa_orders}')
print(f'num_completed_orders: {num_completed_orders}')
print(f'num_refunded_orders: {num_refunded_orders}')
print(f'num_final_rows: {num_final_rows}')
print(f'revenue_by_channel: {revenue_by_channel.to_dict(orient="records")}')
print(f'max_channel: {max_channel}')
print(f'max_revenue: {max_revenue}')"}
